aboutHtml:
We're Isaac and Michelle Russell, locals running STIHL SHOP Nelson since 2019. We know this region and what equipment works here. When you come in, you'll get straightforward advice about what'll suit your place, whether you're looking after a small garden or a larger property.

We stock nine quality brands—STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Bob Cat, Canycom, Hansa Chippers, Honda and Silky. Everything from small hand tools to serious outdoor equipment. Whether you buy in-store or online, our Service Centre offers ongoing repairs, service and parts. We're here to make sure your gear keeps running well.

Come in and let's work out what equipment will do the job for you.
